headline: V26-3126: one declaration on the base sets a repository's delivery posture

V26-3124.title: Let a repository declare its delivery posture, focused or gate, in the harness

criteria.text: With focused declared on the base, verify passes a candidate with no gate record, reporting the posture and its source; gate, record and resume report the same outcome
A candidate changing the posture, or pointing baseRef elsewhere, gets no benefit until that change is on the base
A missing, malformed or unreadable declaration behaves as gate
Repositories that declare nothing behave exactly as they do today
Adoption notes map every Athena site to what replaces it, and the built runtime exports the resolver those sites need

V26-3125.title: Make run-delivery's supervisor honour the focused posture at close-out

criteria.text: With focused declared on the base, a delivery closes with no fullHealth run, and the record names the posture and its source
With gate declared, or nothing declared, close-out behaviour is unchanged
A candidate or lead checkout declaring focused gets no benefit until the declaration is on the base
A malformed or unreadable declaration behaves as gate, with a named reason
orchestration-binding/1 is unchanged and fullHealth stays required
The views and close-out summary say the run was skipped under the posture, not that it passed

outOfScope: Cutting a release, which waits for the operator's word. The tickets' release scope and Athena's removal of its local version follow as one tracked item, filed at close-out.
Which checks a repository runs under `focused`, and a per-delivery waiver.
`admit`, `check` and `prepare`, which keep their behaviour under either posture.
The hosted action in the harness's `packages/action`, which calls the record check directly. The tickets name four commands, and the action stays as it is.
The two commits on the harness's `main` after `fa63884`, which belong to V26-2347, still in progress.

outcome.summary: One declaration on the base sets a repository's delivery posture.
outcome.text: A repository declares gate or focused in one file on its protected base, and the harness's verify, gate, record and resume and run-delivery's close-out all honour it, so a focused delivery reports its own outcome and closes with no full-health run, while a branch can't declare itself focused.
